verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a SaaS email client, and a product of that kind could plausibly offer an API, CLI, or headless mode, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only in-app automation (triggers, plain-English AI filters, Zapier/MCP integrations). That is adjacent functionality, not a documented way to run the product headlessly or in CI, and probes found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
